value.rationale: The question asks whether choosing a more balanced initial pivot improves every tail risk of Quicksort key comparisons, a natural strengthening of classical ordered means. Showing the first failure at the sharp small-size threshold with opposite CDF inequalities, rather than a single isolated counterexample, identifies an actionable mathematical boundary of stochastic ordering. The 1/180 reversal quantifies why exact arithmetic is necessary.
